title: GdprSpecialCategoryData
description: GDPR-sourced archetype — special categories of personal data under Regulation (EU) 2016/679. Article 9 prohibits processing of sensitive data unless one of ten specific conditions from Article 9(2) is met. Rootless — regulatory compliance dimension. Source: GDPR Article 9(1)-(2).

dataCategory.description: Category of special personal data. Processing is prohibited by default (Art 9(1)) unless a condition from Art 9(2) is met. RACIAL_ETHNIC_ORIGIN, POLITICAL_OPINIONS, RELIGIOUS_PHILOSOPHICAL_BELIEFS, TRADE_UNION_MEMBERSHIP: Art 9(1). GENETIC_DATA, BIOMETRIC_DATA: for uniquely identifying a natural person (Art 9(1)). HEALTH_DATA, SEX_LIFE_SEXUAL_ORIENTATION: Art 9(1).

processingCondition.description: The condition under Art 9(2) that permits processing. EXPLICIT_CONSENT: Art 9(2)(a). EMPLOYMENT_SOCIAL_SECURITY_LAW: Art 9(2)(b). VITAL_INTERESTS: Art 9(2)(c). LEGITIMATE_ACTIVITIES: foundation/association/non-profit with appropriate safeguards (Art 9(2)(d)). MANIFESTLY_PUBLIC: data manifestly made public by the data subject (Art 9(2)(e)). LEGAL_CLAIMS: establishment, exercise, defence of legal claims (Art 9(2)(f)). SUBSTANTIAL_PUBLIC_INTEREST: Art 9(2)(g). HEALTH_CARE: Art 9(2)(h). PUBLIC_HEALTH: Art 9(2)(i). ARCHIVING_RESEARCH_STATISTICS: Art 9(2)(j).

processingConditionMet.description: Whether the applicable processing condition under Art 9(2) has been satisfied, permitting processing of the special category data.

additionalSafeguards.description: Whether additional safeguards required by the applicable processing condition are in place. Several Art 9(2) conditions require specific safeguards (e.g., Art 9(2)(b) requires authorisation by EU/Member State law with appropriate safeguards).
